account-locked: Kuo loka fakataimi ʻa e ʻakauni koeʻuhi ko e lahi ʻo e ngaahi feinga hū ki loto naʻe tō. Kātaki ʻo toe feinga ʻamui ange.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: Ko e Cloud Panel ʻoku maʻa e SuperAdmin pē, ʻi he tomeini ʻo e Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Mo e WeKan ʻi Weddy, ʻoku tokoniʻi ʻe he Cloud Panel ha ngaahi tomeini WeKan lahi mei ha sēvea pē ʻe taha, pea ʻoku taki taha maʻu ʻene fakamatala pē ʻaʻana. ʻI he tomeini ʻo e Cloud Panel, ʻoku puleʻi ʻe he SuperAdmin ʻa e ngaahi tomeini mo CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: ʻI ha kī CloudFlare API, ko ha tomeini ʻoku ʻi hoʻo ʻakauni CloudFlare hono sone ʻe maʻu ha lēkooti DNS ʻoku fou ʻi he proxy mo ha tohi fakamoʻoni CloudFlare Origin. ʻOku maʻu ʻe he ngaahi tomeini kehe ha tohi fakamoʻoni Let's Encrypt. ʻOku tauhi ʻa e kī ʻi he sēvea pea ʻe ʻikai toe fakahā ia.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: ʻOku ʻikai ha kī CloudFlare API kuo tauhi: ʻoku maʻu ʻe he tomeini kotoa pē ha tohi fakamoʻoni Let's Encrypt.
